4–6+ years of proven experience in logistics, supply chain, or transportation management, with a clear track record of owning outcomes and exceeding targets independently.
Hands-on experience booking, managing, and negotiating with trucking and freight carriers.
Exposure to CRM or TMS platforms, with the ability to quickly adopt new operational tools.
A sharp, proactive problem-solving mindset. You identify issues before they surface, make decisions with incomplete information, and act without waiting to be told.
Exceptional organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
You follow up, follow through, and keep complex workflows moving across multiple orders simultaneously.
Strong negotiation skills and stakeholder communication.
You can influence up, down, and across an organization with clarity and confidence.
Demonstrated ability to lead informally by mentoring junior colleagues, setting standards, and elevating the people around you without needing a formal management title.
A highly self-directed and reliable working style, with the maturity to manage your own workload while contributing to a fast-moving, collaborative team.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, as well as proficiency across the full Microsoft Office Suite or Google Workspace.
Fluency in English is required.
Own the end-to-end logistics process across the United States, making sharp, well-reasoned decisions to keep orders on track across quality, speed, fill rate, communication, and cost.
Lead value engineering initiatives related to transportation, identifying structural opportunities to improve order profitability and delivery performance at scale, not just one shipment at a time.
Negotiate with nurseries, suppliers, and transport partners at a senior level, securing advantageous terms while strengthening the strategic relationships that keep the supply chain resilient.
Manage a high volume of active orders simultaneously with precision, following up diligently, anticipating problems before they escalate, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.
Communicate proactively with upper management by surfacing risks and wins early, escalating issues with full context, and driving resolution rather than waiting for direction.
Resolve post-order issues thoroughly and systemically by diagnosing root causes, implementing corrective action, and closing the loop so problems do not recur.
Mentor and develop junior logistics specialists by sharing your expertise, raising team standards, and stepping in as an operational lead when upper management needs support.
Drive process improvement across the logistics function by identifying efficiency gaps, proposing data-informed solutions, and helping implement changes that protect revenue and scale effectively.
Support senior leadership with strategic logistics initiatives and ad hoc priorities as they arise.
Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Deep familiarity with logistics, customs brokerage, and import/export compliance.
Background in the landscaping, horticulture, or wholesale plant materials industry.
Proven experience formally or informally mentoring junior team members in a logistics or supply chain environment.
Work Location: Remote

***THIS IS NOT A VIRTUAL POSITION, YOU MUST LIVE WITHIN OR BE WILLING TO RELOCATE WITHIN A COMMUTABLE DISTANCE OF THE DUTY LOCATION*** The person in this position works with the Veteran Transportation Service (VTS) Supervisory Mobility Manager for transportation workload forecasting, scheduling design, procedure development, and quality improvement implementation, modification of processes, evaluation, and ongoing operational flow of the Veteran Transportation Services program.

The coordination of transportation function is multi-faceted and diverse. The three major areas of responsibility are: (1) Scheduling, Data Collection, & Tracking Support; (2) Consult Management responsibilities; (3) Program Support responsibilities.

The person in this position must have knowledge of clinical services, related software, and programs as they relate to clinical computing and office automation. Major duties include but are not limited to: Performs work involving consult management, appointment scheduling and admissions scheduling.

Daily responsibilities include collecting, compiling, and tracking data and statistical information in support of Veteran Transportation Service (VTS). Performs a basic analysis of the data and generates a variety of reports.

Reviews documents, reports and/or applications for omissions and inconsistencies and ensures data entry is complete and accurate. Enters pertinent information into an automated tracking system. Coordinates service practices that decrease waits and delays for patients in all specialty areas.

Utilizes the Veterans Health Information System & Technological Architecture (VISTA), Computerized Patient Record Systems (CPRS) or SharePoint Consult/Request Tracking System in processing internal consultations. Plans for, organizes, administers, and directs how the work will be accomplished for the VTS program.

Planning responsibilities require consideration of support services e.g., systems management, operations, workload forecasting, review, and reporting of data/statistical results of program/project studies, vehicle maintenance and repair, etc. Coordinates the day-to-day operation of VTS program flow, processes, and functions.

Plans and provides support services in the following types of program areas: electronic records management; driver scheduling setup & management; space utilization services. Provides advice to operating managers and supervisors on how provided services assist in accomplishing their missions and programs. Performs other related duties as assigned.

Work Schedule: 1 vacancy in Durham, NC and 2 vacancies in Garner, NC. Monday through Friday, 7:30am to 4:00pm Recruitment & Relocation Incentives: Not authorized Critical Skills Incentive (CSI): Not Approved
To qualify for this position at the GS-6 level, you must meet the following requirement: Specialized Experience: You must have at least one (1) full year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the next lower grade level (GS-05) in the Federal Service, that is directly related to the work of the position and has equipped you with the particular knowledge, skills and abilities to successfully perform the duties as a Transportation Assistant - Transportation Coordinator.

Qualifying specialized experience includes performing transportation support duties such as coordinating connections/scheduling, documenting travel information; collecting, compiling and tracking data on a daily basis; performing a basic analysis of data and generating a variety of reports; entering data into automated tracking databases; and planning and directing a program that provides support services.

NOTE: One (1) full year of work is considered to be 35-40 hours of work per week. Part-time experience will be credited on the basis of time actually spent in appropriate activities.

Applicants wishing to receive credit for such experience must indicate clearly the nature of their duties and responsibilities in each position and the number of hours a week spent in such employment.

Physical Requirements and Work Environment: The person in this position will be exposed to stressful working situations that require a professional attitude and collective reasoning. The person in this position is subject to a high volume of work, the need for accuracy, frequency of interruptions and ever-changing demands due to program changes.

Duties will be predominantly performed in the Veteran Transportation Service program office with intermittent trips to various locations throughout the Medical Center's catchment area both in and near patient care areas where there may be risk of exposure to disease.

For more information on these qualification standards, please visit the United States Office of Personnel Management's website at https://www.opm.gov/policy-data-oversight/classification-qualifications/general-schedule-qualification-standards/.

Logistics Specialist (Global Clinical Distribution)
---------------------------------------------------
Roche Switzerland bridges the gap between pharmaceuticals and diagnostics. Important research and development functions are located here. For our long-term client, F. Hoffmann-La Roche AG in Kaiseraugst, we are looking for a
**Logistics Specialist (Global Clinical Distribution)**
=======================================================
**Background:**
The Clinical Distribution organisation's objective is to cost-effectively ensure the right product is in the right place at the right time every time, such that no patient will go without treatment and no clinical trial will be delayed.

The Logistics Specialist is a key member of the Network \& Capability chapter, which is jointly accountable for all elements of clinical supply chain distribution for the global Roche/Genentech portfolio of \>500 studies.

The global Network \& Capability chapter is responsible for the logistic framework and setup to enable optimized and reliable clinical distribution for all studies (more than 100k shipments yearly across \>130 countries), through effective use of industry- leading clinical distribution strategies (e.g. direct 2 patients), processes and systems.
The Logistics Specialist role executes all shipments and ensures they are processed without interruptions and in line with country requirements. The Logistics Specialist partners closely with the internal and external logistics partners and the broader distribution community (incl. all Chapters), IT and the Roche network to enable the portfolio and pipeline delivery.

* Operational order management and handling of clinical supply shipments (incl. IMP), incl. drop shipments were applicable
* Responsible to manage all relevant documents/licenses considering country specific requirements
* Monitor shipments to ensure on-time delivery to proactively address potential challenges and interruptions
* Responsible for managing and keeping country specific requirements and keeping them up to date
* Acts as the main contact for stakeholders and partners on all shipping and logistics related questions and activities
* Closely collaborates with the various site logistics teams, incl. warehouse (KAU and SSF), transportation and customs management
* Involvement in projects and initiatives after relevant time spent in the role

* Degree / Vocational Training: Completed degree or apprenticeship
* Mandatory background in (Clinical) Supply Chain, Logistics, Freight Forwarding, or related fields
* Alternative Backgrounds: Degrees in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Biochemistry, Chemistry, etc., are accepted only if subsequent work experience in Supply Chain / Logistics is clearly demonstrated
* Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience
* GDP (Good Distribution Practice) experience is strictly required (GMP is a plus)
* ERP Systems: SAP knowledge is nice-to-have, but experience with alternative domain-specific ERP/Logistics tools is accepted
* Office Applications: Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office or Google Workspace is mandatory
* German \& English: Business-fluent (proficient with industry-specific vocabulary).

* Mindset \& Drive: Strong sense of urgency, proactive mindset, and ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
* System Affinity: High affinity for IT systems/ERP, with hands-on experience in SAP considered a strong plus
**What you will be offered:**
* An opportunity to work in one of the world's most important pharmaceutical companies
* Modern campus with plenty of green spaces and meeting areas
* Central location in Basel
* Varied job profile
* Further training opportunities through temptraining
* Working in a dynamic and motivated team

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Procurement and Logistics Specialist to support the daily procurement and logistics requirements of the Clinic Operations function in the United Kingdom. This is an entry-level procurement role designed to support the operational scaling of Neko Health's UK clinic network as new sites open.

The role holder will be responsible for ensuring the smooth functioning of day-to-day ordering, supplier coordination, and logistics workflows supporting clinic consumables, supplies, and operational materials.
The ideal candidate will be hands-on, process-oriented, and comfortable working in a dynamic, scaling environment, contributing to and refining the foundational procurement processes already established for UK clinic operations.

Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Clinic Operations, Finance, and the wider Procurement team (including the US Clinic Operations Specialist, for shared process learnings) to ensure alignment and transparency.
Support the preparation of procurement performance reports and KPIs.
Contribute to catalogue management and preferred supplier frameworks for clinic consumables.

## About Our Client ##
Maison familiale suisse basé à Genève, et reconnue pour son savoir-faire, son exigence de qualité et son attachement à l'innovation.
L'entreprise franchit une nouvelle étape dans l'évolution de ses opérations logistiques, avec la mise en place d'un environnement de stockage presque entièrement automatisé.
Nous recherchons un(e) **Responsable Logistique** pour accompagner cette évolution, assurer la bonne gestion des stocks et des flux internes, et développer les compétences d'une équipe d'environ 20 collaborateurs.
## Job Description ##
Management et développement de l'équipe
* Encadrer, animer et accompagner une équipe d'environ 20 collaborateurs évoluant dans un environnement de stockage.
* Identifier les compétences et les potentiels au sein de l'équipe, et favoriser leur développement vers des responsabilités élargies, notamment en gestion des stocks.
* Développer la polyvalence et la flexibilité des collaborateurs afin de renforcer la capacité d'adaptation de l'organisation.
* Instaurer un management de proximité, fondé sur la confiance, la communication et l'accompagnement des équipes.
Gestion des stocks et des flux internes
* Superviser la réception des matières premières ainsi que la gestion des stocks de matières premières, de produits semi-finis et de produits finis.
* Garantir la fiabilité des mouvements de stocks et la bonne circulation des produits entre les différents ateliers.
* Assurer la coordination des flux internes, depuis la réception des matières premières jusqu'à la mise à disposition des produits finis.
* Superviser les opérations de préparation et de picking lorsque les besoins spécifiques des clients le nécessitent.
* Coordonner les inventaires et contribuer à l'amélioration de la fiabilité des données de stock.
Analyse et amélioration continue
* Analyser les flux, les niveaux de stock et les indicateurs de performance afin d'identifier les axes d'amélioration.
* Proposer et mettre en œuvre des actions visant à optimiser l'organisation et l'efficacité des opérations logistiques.
* Exploiter les données disponibles dans SAP et Excel pour assurer un suivi rigoureux de l'activité et faciliter la prise de décision.
* Accompagner l'évolution des méthodes de travail dans le contexte du déménagement et de l'automatisation du nouvel entrepôt.
* Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Planning, Achats & Approvisionnement, Production et Customer Service afin de garantir la cohérence des flux.
## The Successful Applicant ##
* Formation supérieure en logistique, Supply Chain ou domaine équivalent.
* Expérience confirmée en management d'équipes logistiques, idéalement dans un environnement de stockage et de gestion des stocks.
* Solide compréhension des enjeux liés aux stocks, aux flux internes et à la coordination avec la production.
* Capacité à identifier les compétences et les potentiels au sein d'une équipe, et à développer la polyvalence des collaborateurs.
* Bonnes capacités analytiques et aptitude à exploiter les données pour identifier des améliorations concrètes.
* Maîtrise de SAP et excellente maîtrise d'Excel.
* Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement opérationnel exigeant, à gérer les priorités et à faire face aux imprévus.
Au-delà des compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personnalité accessible, honnête et bienveillante, qui privilégie une approche pragmatique et collaborative du management.
Vous appréciez le terrain et le contact avec les équipes, tout en étant capable de prendre de la hauteur pour structurer, analyser et améliorer les opérations. Vous souhaitez vous inscrire dans un projet à long terme et contribuer durablement au développement de l'organisation.
La maîtrise de l'anglais n'est pas requise.
## What's on Offer ##
* L'opportunité de rejoindre une entreprise familiale suisse reconnue pour son savoir-faire et la qualité de ses produits.
* Un rôle clé dans une étape importante de transformation logistique, vers un nouvel environnement de stockage presque entièrement automatisé.
* La responsabilité d'une équipe d'environ 20 collaborateurs, avec un réel potentiel de développement des compétences et de la polyvalence.
* Un environnement de travail collaboratif, au sein d'un département Supply Chain structuré.
* Un contrat à durée indéterminée à 100%, basé à Genève.
* 28 jours de vacances, auxquels s'ajoutent les éventuelles compensations liées aux horaires de travail.
* Une organisation du temps de travail basée sur 41 heures hebdomadaires contractuelles, avec une compensation des heures supplémentaires selon les modalités en vigueur.
* Une possibilité ponctuelle de télétravail, selon les besoins du poste.
* Un parking sur site et une participation aux transports publics.
